status: PROPOSED - NOT AUTHORIZED FOR STRATEGY EXECUTION
purpose: Test whether cross-sectional breadth and fixed 30-minute signal formation can produce stable multi-hour ETF evidence without reopening broad SPY/QQQ five-minute search.
economic_mechanisms: sector-relative information diffusion over a fixed multi-hour horizon
temporary sector-relative price pressure followed by multi-hour reversal

universe.selection_rule: Use every sector ETF in the frozen Rapid-004 final universe plus its small- and mid-cap broad equity sleeves. Selection uses prior non-return liquidity, completeness, product, and duplicate-exposure evidence only.

allowed_strategy_features: ETF return relative to SPY over one or two completed 30-minute bars
same-clock cumulative relative volume against twenty strictly prior complete sessions
data.raw_immutability: Retain every mapped transport record unchanged. Publish normalized Parquet only after full validation.

feature_definitions.thirty_minute_bar: Aggregate six consecutive complete XNYS regular-session 5m bars: first open, maximum high, minimum low, last close, and summed volume.
feature_definitions.lookback_return: For L in {1,2}, divide the 11:30 completed 30m close by the completed 30m close exactly L bars earlier and subtract one.
feature_definitions.residual_return: Subtract SPY lookback_return from the traded ETF lookback_return for the same L and timestamp.
feature_definitions.same_clock_relative_volume: Divide ETF volume summed over the 24 complete regular-session 5m bars in [09:30, 11:30) New York time by the arithmetic mean of the same sum over exactly twenty strictly prior complete XNYS sessions.
feature_definitions.undefined_input_rule: A missing, duplicate, nonpositive-price, nonpositive-volume-denominator, incomplete-history, or nonfinite required input is a terminal data failure, not a flat signal.

strategy_contract.selection_rule: Select up to three eligible symbols in family rank order. Break equal residual returns by symbol ascending. Each selected symbol receives one-third weight; absent slots stay cash and weights are never rescaled.
strategy_contract.active_session_definition: A session with at least one selected symbol and at least one completed candidate round trip; completed round trips count per selected symbol.
strategy_contract.entry_and_exit_clock_rule: Create the entry target after 11:30. Create the exit target exactly hold_30m_bars times 30 minutes later. Apply the scenario fill delay to both targets; every supported exit fill must precede the regular-session close.
strategy_contract.immediate_neighbor_rule: Configurations in the same family differ by one adjacent value on exactly one axis.

benchmark_contract.definition: On each candidate-active session, hold SPY from the candidate entry target through the same scheduled exit at gross weight equal to the candidate's total target gross weight. Remain in cash on candidate-inactive sessions.
benchmark_contract.comparability: Use the same initial cash, timestamps, fill delay, spread percentile, fees, and candidate activation trace. The trace is an input to the benchmark and cannot change after candidate publication.
benchmark_contract.exposed_accounting: Discovery and walk-forward reports include paired benchmark metrics without a separate run specification.
benchmark_contract.controlled_accounting: Each controlled block uses one candidate Normal specification and one separately stored benchmark Normal specification bound to the frozen candidate trace.

execution_costs.precondition: Freeze and independently review a new symbol-specific SIP quote calibration before any strategy run.
execution_costs.normal: symbol p75 adverse half-spread per fill plus regulatory fees; one 5m fill-delay bar
execution_costs.stress_a: symbol p95 adverse half-spread per fill plus regulatory fees; two 5m fill-delay bars
execution_costs.stress_b: symbol p99 adverse half-spread per fill plus regulatory fees; three 5m fill-delay bars
execution_costs.normal_delay_2: symbol p75 adverse half-spread per fill plus regulatory fees; two 5m fill-delay bars
execution_costs.normal_delay_3: symbol p75 adverse half-spread per fill plus regulatory fees; three 5m fill-delay bars
execution_costs.zero_cost_diagnostic: zero spread and fees with one 5m fill-delay bar; no promotion authority
execution_costs.capacity_rule: Fail when proposed order notional exceeds one percent of the symbol's median close-times-volume across every regular-session 5m bar in exactly twenty strictly prior complete sessions.

campaign_sequence.purpose: Run the eight fixed configurations on exposed chronology and complete discovery, walk-forward, neighbor, stress, and delay gates.
family_base_selection_order: worst fixed-block Normal excess return versus the benchmark descending
aggregate Normal excess return versus the benchmark descending
final_candidate_selection_order: every walk-forward, neighbor, stress, and delay gate passed
worst Normal fold excess return versus the benchmark descending
aggregate Normal excess return versus the benchmark descending

campaign_sequence.purpose: Evaluate at most one frozen candidate and its fixed benchmark on two future blocks.
preconditions: campaign 1 freezes exactly one all-gate candidate
the next controlled block is complete and isolated
user grants separate one-use controlled authority for that block
controlled-b remains inaccessible unless controlled-a passes every block gate and the user grants a new one-use authority

discovery_gates: aggregate Normal return greater than zero
aggregate zero-cost return greater than zero
aggregate Normal return greater than the participation-matched SPY Normal return
at least two of three fixed blocks have positive Normal return
at least two of three fixed blocks have positive Normal excess return versus the benchmark
at least 60 active sessions in each fixed block
at least 300 aggregate completed round trips
average gross trade edge at least max(5 bps, three times modeled round-trip friction)
cost to gross profitable-trade profit no more than 0.35
positive-profit symbol concentration no more than 0.35
positive-profit block concentration no more than 0.60
paired Normal and zero-cost signal traces match exactly
walk_forward_and_robustness_gates: aggregate Normal and zero-cost returns greater than zero
aggregate Normal return greater than the participation-matched SPY Normal return
at least seven of nine Normal folds positive
at least six of nine Normal folds beat the participation-matched SPY Normal return
worst Normal fold return at least -0.01
positive-profit symbol concentration no more than 0.35
both immediate neighbors have positive aggregate Normal return
median immediate-neighbor Normal profit retention at least 0.50
Stress A and normal-delay-2 retain at least 0.50 of Normal profit
Stress B and normal-delay-3 retain at least 0.25 of Normal profit
every stress and delay variant has at least seven positive folds
all discovery accounting, trace, edge, and cost invariants still pass

each_block: candidate Normal return greater than zero
candidate Normal return greater than the participation-matched SPY Normal return
average gross trade edge at least max(5 bps, three times modeled round-trip friction)
cost to gross profitable-trade profit no more than 0.35
positive-profit symbol concentration no more than 0.35
controlled_evaluation_gates.sequence: Freeze the candidate, source, formulas, benchmark, costs, and gates before controlled-a. If controlled-a fails any gate, stop without acquiring or opening controlled-b. If controlled-a passes, require a new one-use authorization before controlled-b.
controlled_evaluation_gates.final_pass: Both blocks must independently pass every block gate. Aggregation cannot rescue a failed block, and no reselection, retuning, substitute range, or gate change is allowed.

global_stopping_rules: stop when any stage has no survivor
stop on any protected-boundary or data-isolation breach
stop on a terminal deterministic failure or exhausted third infrastructure attempt
do not add or invert a family after results
do not add a parameter, symbol, feature, chronology, range, retry class, or weaker gate
do not inspect a partial stage for adaptation
exact_user_decision_requested: Authorize or reject implementation planning and historical acquisition planning for this proposal. Authorization must not grant data acquisition or strategy execution; those require later reviewed artifacts and explicit approval.
